metadata.description: SCHEMATIC outlines of Namibia's main metallogenic belts, hand-drawn for demonstration. Replace with Geological Survey of Namibia (GSN) polygons for real use.

properties.name: Central Damara Zone (Erongo)
properties.description: Granite/alaskite-hosted uranium, pegmatite Li-Sn-Ta and orogenic gold; Namibia's uranium province.

properties.name: Matchless Amphibolite Belt / Southern Damara
properties.description: Besshi-type volcanogenic massive sulphide Cu-Zn deposits (e.g. Otjihase, Matchless).

properties.name: Otavi Mountainland
properties.description: Carbonate-hosted Cu-Pb-Zn-V deposits (Tsumeb, Kombat, Berg Aukas, Abenab).

properties.name: Northern Zone (Otjiwarongo)
properties.description: Northern Damara margin with orogenic gold (Otjikoto), graphite and carbonatite complexes (Okorusu).

properties.name: Ekuja Dome / Omitiomire
properties.description: Shear-hosted copper in basement inliers north-east of Windhoek.

properties.name: Otjozondu Manganese Field
properties.description: Sedimentary manganese deposits east of Okahandja.

properties.name: Kaoko Belt (Kunene)
properties.description: North-west coastal belt with sediment-hosted copper and the Lofdal carbonatite REE field.

properties.name: Gariep Belt (Rosh Pinah)
properties.description: SEDEX-type Zn-Pb (Rosh Pinah) and non-sulphide zinc (Skorpion).

properties.name: Namaqua Metamorphic Province
properties.description: Porphyry copper (Haib) and other base-metal deposits along the Orange River.

properties.name: Sperrgebiet Diamond Coast
properties.description: Coastal and beach placer diamonds; marine diamonds extend offshore.

properties.name: Kalahari Copper Belt (Namibian section)
properties.description: Sediment-hosted Cu-Ag belt continuing from Botswana's Ghanzi area into eastern Namibia.
